changelog: Named notes you can grow by voice. Say 'append to passwords: Instagram hunter2' and DensAssistant starts a note titled 'passwords', then appends each value you add after that — ask 'what's my Instagram password?' later and it answers from your own memory, 100% on-device. Keep a sensitive note off any cloud brain with 'vault my passwords note' (or the 🔒 toggle). Deliberate notes are stored as-is, so nothing you save on purpose gets redacted.
